stories.title: Payton: Broncos can't keep relying on comebacks
stories.summary: In their latest wild ending, the Broncos rebounded from a dismal first half to score 30 points in the second in a 30-26 victory over the Rams.

stories.title: U.S. rallies to win 11th straight Presidents Cup
stories.summary: The Americans won for the 11th straight time Sunday with the most lopsided singles session in Presidents Cup history.

stories.title: Saints confused after again ending up on losing end of fumble ruling
stories.summary: The Saints walked away from Sunday's home loss to the Raiders just as confused about the application of the quarterback fumble rules as they were in Week 1.

stories.title: Ravens win in wild finish after Cowboys' kick paves way to Loop walk-off FG
stories.summary: Lamar Jackson, Tyler Loop and the Ravens delivered one of the most remarkable last-second victories in recent NFL history Sunday, thanks to a late fourth-quarter decision made by the Cowboys.

stories.title: Bucs QB Mayfield has dislocated thumb, will undergo MRI
stories.summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield suffered a dislocated right thumb in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 23-16 loss to the Vikings, coach Todd Bowles said.
